messages:
Sylas Rivera: hey team — i’m Sylas, joined the infra squad today! remote in PDX, usually on from 9–5 PT. excited to meet folks :wave:
Maya Sato: welcome Sylas!! where are you sitting when you’re in the office? :) :tada:
Sylas Rivera: thanks Maya — I’ll be at the 3rd-floor east bench for the next few weeks, desk by the windows. big fan of plants and terrible dad jokes :seedling::grin:
Noor Habs: welcome! we have a small plant swap shelf by the kitchen if you want to grab a pothos
Arlo Jensen: pings for badge pickup: go to #people-ops desk and say you’re with infra. they open at 10:30 today — FYI :calendar:
Sylas Rivera: perfect — thanks Arlo, I’ll swing by after the intro meeting
Talia Bhat: quick lunch poll — tacos by the roof or ramen on 2nd? Sylas — what’s your pick? :burrito::ramen:
Sylas Rivera: tacos please. also caffeine level: large americano ☕️
Maya Sato: road trip for tacos :thumbsup: meet at 12:30 at elevator A?
Noor Habs: FYI onboarding-bot scheduled a "New Hire Coffee" event at 11:00 — it shows up on your calendar, Sylas
onboarding-bot: Welcome Sylas! An onboarding buddy (Maya Sato) has been assigned. Check your DMs for next steps. :robot_face:
Arlo Jensen: if you’re into hikes, there’s a small crew hitting Forest Park this Saturday morning — low effort, high snack potential. Sylas, you in?
Sylas Rivera: that sounds great — count me in. first weekend with the team!
Maya Sato: also pro tip: there’s a secret stash of granola bars in the meeting-room closet labeled "Sam's emergency snacks" — now you know :eyes:
Talia Bhat: welcome again Sylas, can’t wait to pair on infra stuff. drop a note in #eng when you’re ready to pair on setup
Sylas Rivera: will do — thanks everyone, really glad to be here :)
